snippet.title: poncle presents | Berserk or Die - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Need a new game to void the warranty on your peripherals? Berserk or Die is available now on Steam ⚔️

Take on the role of a lone soldier left standing on a burning battlefield. Your goal is simple, overpower the hordes of oncoming enemies and survive for as long as you can.

This action slash 'em up has a never-seen-before button-mashing control scheme where the more buttons you press, the more powerful your attacks become!

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874130/Berserk_or_Die/
🔗 Steam News: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2874130/view/500574015912411439
🔗 FAQ: https://poncle.games/berserk-or-die-faq.html
🔗 Nao Games Twitter: https://x.com/nao_peca
